# Replaid

> Replaid is an AI inbox assistant that helps businesses turn messages into leads. It unifies conversations from channels like Instagram, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Telegram, and more, then uses AI to qualify leads, send on-brand replies, and trigger workflows.

Canonical website: https://replaid.pro
Web app: https://app.replaid.pro
Primary contact: https://replaid.pro/contact

## Preferred source pages

- Home: https://replaid.pro/
- Get started: https://replaid.pro/get-started
- Blog index: https://replaid.pro/blog
- Contact: https://replaid.pro/contact
- Privacy policy: https://replaid.pro/privacy
- Terms of use: https://replaid.pro/terms
- Cookie policy: https://replaid.pro/cookies

## Product facts

- Category: AI inbox assistant for sales, support, and lead qualification
- Best for: small businesses, agencies, creators, and teams managing high message volume
- Core value: centralize inbound conversations, detect high-intent leads, reply instantly, and reduce missed opportunities
- Setup: no-code onboarding with connected channels, brand guidelines, knowledge sources, and workflows
- Availability: web-based software application
